Vendored from https://github.com/AustinZ21/cinematic-skills (MIT, see LICENSE), unmodified.
- `depthshot.js` — WebGL2 depth-parallax camera: real parallax + motion blur from ONE still (archive photo).
- `prep_plate.py` — depth map for a still (Depth Anything V2). Its Swin2SR upscale step is AI super-resolution: do NOT use it on archive evidence (invents detail); upscale with Lanczos instead.
- `flash_check.py` — scans a render for flashes/strobes.
- `contact_sheet.py` — contact sheets for review.
